name: liquid-metal-gold-dress-night-flash
image_purpose: night flash, bridge, metallic fabric, and urban portrait reference

prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-contrast nighttime portrait of an approved adult woman beside an illuminated cable-stayed bridge.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight dark-chestnut hair, natural skin texture, soft candid smile, beige crossbody bag, delicate pendant, and a metallic gold knee-length short-sleeve dress with secure coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium full-body third-person shot, subject leaning lightly against a white slatted bridge railing with arms relaxed, bridge cables and dark urban foliage sharp in the background, no artificial bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard direct smartphone flash around 6500K, bright metallic highlights, sharp shadow behind subject, visible digital grain in deep shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone-style photography, portrait 3:4, direct flash, everything sharp, realistic metallic texture, high dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long straight dark-chestnut hair stands beside a white bridge railing at night in a metallic gold knee-length short-sleeve dress with secure coverage, beige crossbody bag, and small pendant. Use direct hard smartphone flash, sharp bridge cables, dark foliage, bright metallic highlights, and raw digital grain. No body-part emphasis or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, strapless mini dress, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, exaggerated bust or hips, artificial bokeh, blurry bridge, distorted anatomy, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
